about: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next EXL3 3.05 bpw on one Arc Pro B70 with NEXTN MTP in 12 GB of host RAM: routed experts and the MTP layer's experts on NVMe behind the VRAM cache and a 0.5 GB RAM tier, exact (decode misses are read from NVMe while the kernel waits, never masked), one prefill staging buffer, n-gram table on NVMe, 262,144 context, vision; for hosts with 16 GB RAM
setup: Requires one Intel Arc Pro B70 32 GB, 12 GB of free host RAM (a 16 GB machine), and 132 GB on a local NVMe SSD: 85.14 GB of weights plus the 46.8 GB packed expert store that the image's pack-store step builds once (prepare; 49 layers including the MTP draft's MoE layer). Routed experts and the MTP layer's experts stay on NVMe behind the VRAM expert cache (8,000 slots) and a 0.5 GB RAM tier; a decode pick that is in neither is read from NVMe while the MoE kernel waits (exact decode miss path, EXL3_EXACT_MISS), so no expert pick is ever masked; VRAM evictions are not written back (EXL3_NVTIER_NO_VICTIM). One prefill staging buffer (EXL3_NVTIER_STAGE_HOSTBUF=1) and a 0.5 GB n-gram row cache keep the RAM down; the n-gram (engram) table is read from NVMe. NEXTN MTP 3 steps / 4 draft tokens. Context 262,144 tokens with a 270,336-token fp8 KV cache; vision (images). Measured on omarchy (EPYC 7443P, PCIe 4.0 x16, md RAID0 of 4x Samsung 9100 PRO, xfs): container-held RAM (anon + shmem PSS) peak 11.65 GB while serving (median 11.58); local-ai-recipe-kit sweep prefill 896-912 tok/s from 8K to 64K, decode 32.6-33.2 tok/s aggregate at 1-4 users, C1 at 32K 35.4; reference panel top-1 0.9883, KL 0.00118; needle 233,529 tokens pass. The container limit (16 GiB) leaves headroom for the shutdown path.
